encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.note: Pollux 7, 65 (οἱ θύσανοι) καὶ κροσσοὶ δοκοῖεν ἂν ὠνομάσθαι Ἀραρότος εἰπόντος ἐν Καινεῖ κτλ. ἔνιοι γὰρ οὕτω γράφουσιν ἀντὶ τοῦ κροκωτούς. Pollucem κροσ(σ)ωτούς scripsisse manifestum est. poetam κροκωτούς dedisse censet Meinekius, κροσός Atticis abiudicans. — Caenei anceps inter marem feminamque species designari videtur.

lg.l: ἡ σὴ θυγάτηρ, ὅτ’ ἐκεῖνος αὐτὴν ἐπελέκα.

div.note: Bekker. Anecd. 112, 18 πελεκᾶν· εὕρηται καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ κακεμφάτου. Ἀραρὼς Καινεῖ κτλ. αὐτὴν Bekker.] αὐτὸν cod. — si filia quae commemoratur Caenis est, Neptunus est qui eam dicitur πελεκῆσαι, adpellatur autem Elatus, Caenidis pater. Preller. Myth. gr.2 II 11.
Ἀραρὼς Καινεῖ. Bekker. Anecd. 81, 32. ὑπηνέμια dicuntur Arist. Av. 695. fr. 186. Plat. com. 19.

ἀντὶ τοῦ θυγατέρα καλεῖν. Ἀραρὼς Καινεῖ. Bekker. Anecd. 99, 30. Meinekius θυγατρίζειν. potius θυγατερίζειν, ut πατερίζειν Arist. Vesp. 652. παππίζειν vel παππάζειν Vesp. 609. ἀδελφίζειν Apolloph. 4. καρδαμίζειν Arist. Thesm. 617.
